input.description: A `Tensor`. N-D with shape `input_shape = [batch] + spatial_shape + remaining_shape`, where spatial_shape has `M` dimensions.

block_shape.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. 1-D with shape `[M]`, all values must be >= 1.
constraints: block_shape must be one of int32, int64

paddings.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. 2-D with shape `[M, 2]`, all values must be >= 0. `paddings[i] = [pad_start, pad_end]` specifies the padding for input dimension `i + 1`, which corresponds to spatial dimension `i`. It is required that `block_shape[i]` divides `input_shape[i + 1] + pad_start + pad_end`.
constraints: paddings must be one of int32, int64, i

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `input`.
